definitions.explanation: A tax levied on personal or corporate income.

examples.japanese: {所得税|しょとくぜい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{納|おさ}める→納める：02280_osameru⟧。
{所得税|しょとくぜい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{確定申告|かくていしんこく}→確定申告：04902_kakuteishinkoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{所得税|しょとくぜい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{引|ひ}かれて→引く：01978_hiku⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。

notes:
{所得税|しょとくぜい} is the tax levied on personal or corporate income in Japan.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {所得税|しょとくぜい}⟦{率|りつ}→率：noentry⟧: income tax rate
- {所得税|しょとくぜい}⟦{控除|こうじょ}→控除：07501_koujo⟧: income tax deduction
- ⟦{累進|るいしん}→累進：27381_ruishin⟧⟦{課税|かぜい}→課税：00203_kazei⟧: progressive taxation
- {所得税|しょとくぜい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{納|おさ}める→納める：02280_osameru⟧: to pay income tax

OTHER MAIN TAXES IN JAPAN:
- ⟦{消費税|しょうひぜい}→消費税：04803_shouhizei⟧: consumption tax (sales tax)
- ⟦{住民税|じゅうみんぜい}→住民税：16806_juuminzei⟧: resident tax (local tax)
- ⟦{法人税|ほうじんぜい}→法人税：noentry⟧: corporate tax

USAGE:
Japan uses progressive taxation - higher income means higher tax rates.
